descripcion: At C2 an opinion is embedded in a wider frame: acknowledging the complexity of the question before answering it, and signalling exactly how confidently the opinion is held. The goal is no longer to have an opinion clearly, but to calibrate how much weight to put behind it.

filas: It's a genuinely difficult question, but if pressed,…
though a strong case exists the other way too.

ejemplos.texto: It's a genuinely difficult question, but if pressed, I'd lean towards thinking it's the former.
I hold that view fairly loosely, to be honest.
Though a strong case exists the other way too.

notas: If pressed signals that the opinion is a considered lean, not a firm conviction — useful when the topic genuinely has no easy answer.
I hold that view loosely is a precise, C2-level way to flag low personal confidence without hedging the actual content.
Naming the counter-view briefly, without arguing it, shows intellectual honesty rather than weakness.

es.en: Spanish has formulas for graded confidence (me inclino a pensar que – I'd lean towards; con reservas – tentatively), so the move itself transfers. Expressions such as I hold that loosely have no fixed Spanish equivalent and are best learned as units.
es.es: El español tiene fórmulas para graduar la certeza («me inclino a pensar que» – «I'd lean towards»; «con reservas» – «tentatively»), por lo que el movimiento retórico se transfiere. Expresiones como «I hold that loosely» no tienen un equivalente fijo en español y conviene aprenderlas como unidades.

de.en: German grades confidence with ich tendiere dazu (I'd lean towards) and vorläufig or mit Vorbehalt (tentatively), so the move transfers well. I hold that loosely has no German equivalent and is best learned as a unit.
de.de: Deutsch stuft Sicherheit mit «ich tendiere dazu» («I'd lean towards») und «vorläufig» oder «mit Vorbehalt» («tentatively») ab, daher lässt sich die Bewegung gut übertragen. «I hold that loosely» hat keine direkte deutsche Entsprechung und sollte als feste Wendung gelernt werden.

it.en: Propendo per corresponds exactly to I'd lean towards, and con beneficio d'inventario to taking something with a pinch of salt. Italian speakers can therefore map most of the confidence scale directly; I hold that loosely needs to be learned as a unit.
it.it: «Propendo per» corrisponde esattamente a «I'd lean towards», e «con beneficio d'inventario» a «taking something with a pinch of salt». Gli italofoni possono quindi mappare gran parte della scala di certezza; «I hold that loosely» va imparato come unità.

fr.en: Je pencherais pour corresponds closely to I'd lean towards, even with the same conditional, and sous réserve to tentatively. The scale transfers well; I hold that loosely has no French equivalent.
fr.fr: «Je pencherais pour» correspond étroitement à «I'd lean towards», jusque dans le conditionnel, et «sous réserve» à «tentatively». L'échelle se transfère bien ; «I hold that loosely» n'a pas d'équivalent français fixe.

pt.en: Inclino-me a pensar que corresponds to I'd lean towards, and com reservas to tentatively. The scale transfers well; I hold that loosely has no Portuguese equivalent and is best learned as a unit.
pt.pt: «Inclino-me a pensar que» ou, no Brasil, «tendo a pensar que» corresponde a «I'd lean towards», e «com reservas» a «tentatively». A escala se transfere bem; «I hold that loosely» não tem equivalente fixo em português e deve ser aprendido como unidade.

errores: Stating an opinion with full confidence on a genuinely contested question, which reads as naive rather than authoritative.
Acknowledging complexity but then never actually answering the question.
Confusing hedging the confidence level with hedging the content itself.

pt: *Até certo ponto* rendered as *Until a certain point* instead of *To some extent*.

mision.consigna: Give your view on whether voluntary simplicity is a real answer or a privilege.
requisitos: the complexity acknowledged first, differently from last time
one *I hold that view fairly loosely*
one condition that would change your mind
use *degrowth*, *voluntary simplicity* and *to be content with less*

microtareas.texto: Write the strongest case against your view.
Write how confidently you really hold it — honestly.
Record 2 minutes on *a throwaway culture*: *I'd lean towards…*

autochequeo: Is the level of confidence calibrated to how contested the question actually is?
Is the counter-view named, even briefly?
Does the opinion actually get answered, not just qualified into silence?
Would an expert on this topic find the confidence level appropriate?
Have I avoided false modesty that just avoids taking any position?
promptCorreccion: Focus only on how the opinion's confidence is calibrated. Check whether the complexity is acknowledged without avoiding the actual answer. Do not rewrite the text.
